title: refactor: unify Claude and Codex capsule assembly
body:
## What changed
- route Claude and Codex adapters through the shared Capsule assembler
- apply the same portable path, redaction, evidence, and Git shaping across all adapters
- add a Claude portable path regression test

## Validation
- `npm run check` (38 tests passing)

title: docs: add project handoff guide
body: Adds a comprehensive handoff document for continuing development in a new window.

title: feat: detect available coding agents
body: Adds cross-platform target detection and a targets CLI command. Detection is read-only and does not launch processes.

title: test: cover JSON handoff protocol
body: Adds end-to-end coverage and fixes argument parsing for the JSON handoff envelope.

title: feat: add machine-readable handoff envelope
body: Adds --format json to handoff, emitting a versioned threadport.handoff.v1 envelope with target agent, validated capsule, and explicit no-execution safety flags.

title: feat: add safe handoff export command
body: Adds a safe handoff command that renders a validated Capsule into a target-agent prompt file. It performs no command execution or workspace mutation.

title: feat: add portable capsule path mode
body:
Adds portable capsule output by default:

- hides machine-specific project and git roots
- normalizes project-relative file/evidence paths
- supports privacy: local for debugging

Validation: npm run check (36 tests).

title: fix: harden capsule state and writes
body:
Implements report-driven hardening:

- fingerprint untracked file contents and support detached HEAD
- strict explicit completion detection
- avoid capsule output collisions across projects
- atomic JSON/Markdown writes
- fix redaction replacement callback

All checks pass locally: npm run check (36 tests).

body:
Bumps [zod](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod) from 3.25.76 to 4.6.1.
Release notes

Sourced from zod's releases.

v4.6.1

A patch on top of 4.6.0.

  • b12aa523 fix: preserve unique tags with defaulted discriminators (#6582) — closes #6577
  • dd9c36fa fix(v4): defer recursive object index inference (#6580)
  • 3b154992 feat(lang): add Tajik (tg) locale (#6581) by @​ismoil77
  • 2efa8b80 ci: give the npm wait a real budget and drop the back-publish path (#6583)

v4.6.0

Zod 4.6 is now available.

npm install zod@latest

At a glance:

  • .validate() — checks input validity without building a result (up to 35x faster than .safeParse().success on a compiled schema)
  • z.instanceof().properties() — validates properties of an instance
  • fromJSONSchema() — enforces six validation keywords it used to ignore
  • z.iban() — electronic-format IBAN plus mod-97 checksum
  • z.withParser() — installs a parser generated elsewhere, for environments without new Function
  • Faster CommonJS — drops the getter on every export (~3x faster z.validate() under require)
  • Memory retention in recursive schemas — releases the parsed input, fixing a 4.5 out-of-memory regression
  • @zod/mini — Zod Mini as a standalone package, versioned in lockstep with zod since 4.5

.validate()

Standalone boolean validation, in Zod, Zod Mini, and Zod Core. It answers "is this input valid?" without constructing a ZodError, which makes rejection cheap. The return type is a guard on the schema's input type.

z.validate(z.string(), "hi"); // true
z.validate(z.string(), 42);   // false

It is a method on Zod Classic schemas too. (#6547)

const Player = z.object({
  username: z.string(),
  xp: z.number(),
});

if (Player.validate(data)) {

data.username; // narrowed

}

In conjunction with z.compile(), this can be up to 35x faster than .safeParse().success on invalid input.

title: feat: add read-only ThreadPort handoff CLI
body:
## Summary
- Frankie-Xu adds a read-only `threadport` CLI: extract, validate, and render Capsule v1 from a local Claude session.
- Default output is `.threadport/` (still gitignored). Writes run `validateCapsule` first and refuse overwrite unless `--force`.
- No `apply` / `exec` / `next_action` execution, no schema change, no MCP.

## Test plan
- [ ] `npm run check` stays green (18 tests)
- [ ] `threadport extract --from claude --session tests/fixtures/claude/session-basic.jsonl --project <git-root>` writes `.threadport/<id>.json` and `.md`
- [ ] `threadport validate` / `render` succeed on that Capsule
- [ ] invalid JSON exits non-zero
- [ ] second extract without `--force` refuses to overwrite
- [ ] extract does not run fixture commands such as `npm test`

title: feat: add Claude Code session adapter
body:
## Summary
- Add a read-only Claude Code session adapter that maps observable local traces onto frozen Capsule v1 fields.
- Keep hidden reasoning and secrets out of the Capsule; do not execute next_action or change the schema.
- Publish through the GitHub API because github.com:443 resets ordinary git push; this PR is the review path into main.

## Test plan
- [ ] `npm run check` stays green (original 9 tests plus the new adapter tests)
- [ ] `createClaudeAdapter().extract()` on `tests/fixtures/claude/session-basic.jsonl` returns a valid Capsule with `source_agent === claude`
- [ ] Fixture secrets and `HIDDEN_REASONING_MARKER_DO_NOT_COPY` do not appear in the Capsule
- [ ] Two extracts with a pinned clock are equal
- [ ] README library call works without a CLI

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
